title: Egg topper
text: Egg topper. I waited to review this cutter until I had given it a fair amount of use and really don't like to leave negative reviews - however, the truth is what it is. After more than 20 uses I can report that it worked properly only 1 time.  I consider that a fail.  I tried researching several different views of "helpful hints."  The best I can say is that holding the egg in one hand, positioning the cutter carefully in one place (very difficult) and spinning the cutter, then pull the top handle up and releasing it.  Then pull the cutter up, it should pull the top of the shell off...  however, it only did this one time and not very well.  I think I agree with other reviewers that a simple knife slice may still be the best option - using the "better mouse trap" theory however, I SO wanted this to work.  *also, the little spoon/scooper (?) they include... it is really just junk in my opinion and I just threw it away.  The cutter itself is quite solid and appears to be stainless steel, the downside is that it is not worth the space in the drawer, sadly.
